shard: rest: every pending row of scripts/data/rosterConfirmation2026.json whose club plays in none of the Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga, La Liga, Primeira Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Premier League, Championship, MLS, Belgian Pro League, Eredivisie or Super Lig, by the league table in src/lib/clubManager.ts. That is the Austrian Bundesliga, Swiss Super League, Saudi Pro League, Scottish Premiership, Super League Greece, SuperSport HNL, Danish Superliga and the Brasileirao (Liga MX has no pending row left).
method: Read with WebFetch on 2026-10-03 (the session's web search budget was spent, so pages were reached by their own navigation, by ESPN's public search endpoint and by the Livesport search endpoint behind Soccerway). Family A is the club's own squad page or the league's own page (bundesliga.at, hnl.hr, slgr.gr, spl.com.sa, ligaportugal.pt, the clubs' sites). Family B is an independent publisher on another host: ESPN's 2026-27 squad and player pages and Soccerway's player pages, which count as two publishers. A row leaves pending when an A and a B source agree on the day read. On 2026-10-03, seventeen rows were settled on ESPN and Soccerway alone because the official page for the club the verdict names would not answer a plain fetch (many club sites render their squad by script, some answered 403, 404 or 522). A review held that against the rule, so on 2026-10-05 those pages were read again in a headless browser, which renders them. Thirteen now carry an official page that agrees (Liga Portugal's club pages for the five Portuguese moves, the clubs' own pages for the rest). Giacomo Bonaventura's notCurrent rests on the league's own Al Shabab page, as the ledger's notCurrent rows do. Andreas Hansen and Topi Keskinen still have no official page that renders a squad, so they are back in pending, with the verdict two publishers support kept under heldOnTwoPublishers. Henry Onyekuru is in pending because the publishers disagree on where he is. A row resting on one publisher stays pending. Namesakes are told apart by the birth date or age the sources print against the baked age in src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts (a 2025 row, so one year younger). Same row shapes as the ledger: confirmedStill rows carry club, movedTo rows carry from, to and realClub, removedClubNotModelled rows carry from and realClub, notCurrent rows carry from and why, pending rows carry club, checkedOn and the reason.

heldOnTwoPublishers.rule: Rows two independent publishers on different hosts agree on, with dated 2026-27 evidence, but whose official page could not be read on 2026-10-03 or 2026-10-05 even in a browser.
